name: Rocket.Chat
description_en: The Secure CommsOS™ for mission-critical operations
readme_excerpt: The ultimate secure open-source solution for team communications Rocket.Chat is an open-source, secure, fully customizable communications platform developed in TypeScript for organizations with high standards of data protection. We are the ultimate solution for team communications, enabling real-time conversations between colleagues, with other companies, and with your customers or citizens, regardless of how they connect with you. The result is an increase in productivity and user satisfaction…
